name: PrimaryNav - Derived Chapters
description: The header menu with the Chapters dropdown hovered open. None of the chapter links is authored in nav.json — they are generated from the chapters collection at render time, and they now sort active cities before forming ones, so a visitor meets the four places that hold events first. DC and Seattle each carry a quiet grey second line, a globe and Online · WhatsApp group: they are online groups for now, not chapters holding events. The dropdown lists places only: the old Global community link that followed the cities moved to its own top-level menu in November 2026, so the cities run straight into Lead or co-lead a chapter, a crimson call to action to the volunteer page set off by a hairline — the one place the menu asks for leads, after per-city Looking for a co-lead notes were tried and removed. The other groups are the hand-authored ones an editor still edits under /admin, and they render identically, which is the point.
